headline: Executive order signed in 2020 aimed at making certain life-saving medicines more affordable for patients.
what_it_does: This executive order is about lowering what patients pay for life-saving medications. No official summary was provided, so the specific drugs, programs, and rules it covers cannot be confirmed from the source material. As an executive order, it directs federal agencies to act rather than creating a new law passed by Congress.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to make these medicines more affordable, though the exact drugs and patients covered are not stated in the source material.
